excerpt.zh:
什……？你……突破了虫洞？怎么做到的？我们的科学家已经研究了很多年都没有成功。这肯定哪里出问题了。

……
……
……

这肯定是场考验。我不信任你们！我们必须从星系中清除你们这些东西！
excerpt.en:
Wha-? You... breached the wormhole? But how? Our best scientists have been working on it for years, without success. There must be some kind of mistake.

...
...
...

This must be a test. You are not to be trusted! We must cleanse our stars of your kind!
